about: Rows of the locks fixed by hand: each was wrong from the start, so no built mod relies on it (sdk/tools/gen_api_lock.py).

fixes.why: The game's function returns nothing and the port's hook point is void(u32): a mod that asked with u32(u32) was refused (OPENRAC_HOOK_SIGNATURE), so none can have used it.
The typedef of the same hook point, with the signature the port has (above).
